data.exact_reserve_text: Overall, on an aggregate basis, a reserve release of GBP 5.7m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2021 (2020 GBP 12.0m).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Large RITC transfer reduced gross claims outstanding by GBP 168,475k in 2020 resulting in lower opening reserves at 1 Jan 2021.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding opened at GBP 145.119m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 12.0m (c.8.3% of opening reserves), driven by adverse development mainly in older underwriting years (notably 2019) partially offset by favourable development in Property classes; however the reported narrative shows a net release of GBP 5.7m after reinsurance. The 2020 year included a large RITC transfer (-GBP 168.475m gross) which materially affected comparatives and net movements.
raw_causal_phrases: Overall, on an aggregate basis, a reserve release of GBP 5.7m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2021 (2020 GBP 12.0m).
The reserve release was primarily due to the favourable development across Property classes partially offset by adverse development on the Legal Indemnities class.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development is not stated explicitly in a single 'movement in prior year claims' gross line. The report states a net release of GBP 5.7m (net of reinsurance). A gross prior-year movement was calculated from the published gross claims development triangle (see claims triangle) giving a gross strengthening of c.GBP 12.037m. The 2020 RITC transfer of GBP 168.475k materially distorts comparatives. Prior-year net vs gross discrepancy flagged (net release vs gross strengthening). Figures derived from triangle are in GBP '000 in the source; converted to millions here.
